action.argument:
command -v tesseract; ls diagnostics; PYTHONPATH=/workspace/vendor python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
import shutil, subprocess
print('OCR executable:', shutil.which('tesseract'))
for p in sorted(__import__('pathlib').Path('inputs').glob('*.png')):
 im=Image.open(p).convert('L'); w,h=im.size
 rows=[sum(im.getpixel((x,y))<100 for x in range(w)) for y in range(h)]
 staff=[y for y,n in enumerate(rows) if n>w*.55]
 top=min(staff) if staff else int(h*.4)
 crop=im.crop((0,0,w,max(1,top-3))).resize((w*4,max(1,top-3)*4))
 out='diagnostics/'+p.stem+'-chords.png'; crop.save(out)
 print(p.name,'staff rows',staff,'crop bottom',top-3)
 if shutil.which('tesseract'):
  r=subprocess.run(['tesseract',out,'stdout','--psm','11'],capture_output=True,text=True)
  print(repr(r.stdout))
PY
